title: Echoes Of Insanity
description: Echoes of Insanity is a high-performance, atmospheric psychological horror plugin designed to turn your Minecraft server into a waking nightmare.
body:
# Echoes of Insanity

> **"You feel someone behind you. You turn... but there is nothing there. Or so you hope."**

**Echoes of Insanity** is a psychological horror plugin that transforms Minecraft into a tense, atmospheric survival experience. Instead of relying on jump scares alone, it slowly erodes the player's sense of safety through hallucinations, environmental changes, and relentless paranoia.

## 🌑 Features

### 🧠 Sanity System

Your sanity slowly drains as you survive. The lower it gets, the more reality begins to break apart.

* Dynamic sanity meter
* Increasingly disturbing events
* Multiple insanity stages
* Nightmare ending when sanity is completely lost

### 👁️ Hallucinations

As your mind deteriorates, you'll begin to experience impossible events.

* Creepy whispers and distant screams
* Heartbeats that grow faster as panic sets in
* Fake players and doppelgängers
* Silent staring cats
* Corrupted experience levels
* "TURN BACK" warning signs
* Random visual glitches

### 👤 The Stalker

Something is always watching.

A mysterious entity silently follows players through the darkness. Look directly at it and it freezes. Look away... and it gets closer.

### 🩸 Gore & Disturbing Effects

Horror isn't just psychological.

* Blood-like particle effects
* Decaying flesh appearances
* Disturbing environmental events
* Corrupted item names and inventory hallucinations

### 🚪 Living Environment

The world itself becomes hostile.

* Permanent midnight atmosphere
* Heavy fog and darkness
* Doors opening and closing on their own
* Random environmental disturbances
* An abandoned starting village

### 💭 The Dream

Escape the nightmare by reaching the edge of the cursed world... if you can survive long enough.

---

## ⚠️ Content Warning

This plugin contains:

* Psychological horror
* Intense suspense
* Disturbing visual effects
* Gore-inspired visuals
* Loud and unsettling audio cues

It is intended to create a genuinely tense horror experience and may not be suitable for all players.

---

## 🎮 Recommended

For the best experience:

* Play with sounds enabled.
* Use headphones.
* Use Solas Shaders 
* Hardcore difficulty
* Turn off bright resource packs.

Some features may not work if you didn't do the recommended settings for the plugin.
